parsed.reason: This is a perfect example of what the rubric calls for. It's a warm, single question about whether the introduction happened ("Did you end up meeting the other family?"), it explicitly removes pressure with the exact phrase needed ("No pressure either way"), it names neither the other family nor describes them in any way (as required since Hale had no information about them), it's short and plain, first person implied, and contains no padding, exclamation marks, emoji, greetings, second questions, requests, or invented specifics. This reads like a friend who genuinely remembered to check back and meant it when they said no pressure.
